value.summary: Management has demonstrated high credibility by delivering on its $2 billion revenue run rate target ahead of schedule and successfully executing a complex, large-scale acquisition of Nagarro. Their ability to maintain growth momentum while integrating significant structural changes and navigating AI-driven industry shifts reinforces investor confidence.

promises.quote: we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027
promises.promised: Reach a $2 billion annual revenue run rate by March 2027.
promises.actual_delivered: Achieved a revenue run rate of $1.95 billion in Q2 FY27 ($487.6M * 4), effectively meeting the target early as confirmed in the Oct 2026 transcript (page 4).
promises.reasoning: The Q2 FY27 revenue of $487.6M puts the company on a run rate of $1.95B, and management confirmed they are serving clients with a $2.9B run rate including Nagarro.

promises.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
promises.promised: Maintain Effective Tax Rate (ETR) between 20% and 24% for FY26.
promises.actual_delivered: The ETR for the full year FY26 stood at 22.6%, as reported in the Apr 2026 transcript (page 8).
promises.reasoning: The final ETR of 22.6% fell squarely within the promised 20-24% range.

promises.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
promises.promised: Target an EBIT margin aspiration of 16% to 17%.
promises.actual_delivered: EBIT margin for Q2 FY27 came in at 15%, down from 16.3% in Q4 FY26, as reported in the Oct 2026 transcript (page 8).
promises.reasoning: Margins fell to 15% in the latest quarter, missing the 16-17% aspirational range due to wage hikes and acquisition costs.

promises.quote: we expect this transaction to close sometime towards the Q4 of Calendar Year 2026 or early Q1 of Calendar Year 2027.
promises.promised: Close the Nagarro acquisition by Q4 CY2026 or Q1 CY2027.
promises.actual_delivered: In Oct 2026 (page 7), management confirmed they expect deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27, remaining on schedule.
promises.reasoning: The timeline remains consistent with the original promise as of the latest reporting.

promises.quote: minimum acceptance threshold for this open offer at 50% plus 1 share.
promises.promised: Secure at least 50% plus one share in the Nagarro open offer.
promises.actual_delivered: Secured approximately 94.04% of Nagarro share capital by the end of the additional acceptance period (Oct 2026, page 6).
promises.reasoning: The acceptance significantly exceeded the minimum threshold required for the deal.

guidance.quote: Over the next two quarters, we expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million to be incurred towards the Nagarro transaction.

guidance.target: Raise USD 1.25 billion through debt and equity
guidance.quote: As a part of this long-term financing strategy, we will be raising USD 1.25 billion in terms of both debt and equity.

bull.point: Strong revenue growth momentum with 26 consecutive quarters of sequential growth.
bull.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 7.8% quarter-on-quarter and 20% year-on-year delivering USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27. This marks our 26th sequential quarter of revenue growth.

bull.point: Successful execution of a massive $650 million large deal in the high-tech sector.
bull.quote: A strong validation of Software Reinvention Services is the large deal we signed last quarter, a 6.5-year engagement worth more than $650 million

bull.point: High acceptance rate for the Nagarro acquisition, enabling a full squeeze-out of minority shareholders.
bull.quote: We have secured approximately 94.04% of Nagarro share capital excluding treasury shares at the expiry of the additional acceptance period

bear.point: Significant margin pressure from wage hikes and large deal amortization costs.

bear.point: Revenue decline in the European region due to client-specific ramp-downs.

bear.point: Substantial one-time transaction expenses impacting reported profitability.
bear.quote: reported PAT includes exceptional one-time expenses as part of Nagarro acquisition, resulting in approximately 3.1% impact for the quarter.
